shorts_extract.hook: 85% of solo intercom listeners bolt out of their booth in 52 seconds — add four lit peer bulbs and 69% stay frozen.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Darley & Latané's 1968 NYU intercom study (diffusion of responsibility) paired with the Columbia smoke room (pluralistic ignorance).
shorts_extract.twist: Sweating non-helpers, the real archival truth behind 1964 Queens headlines, and how pointing to ONE person fixes the bug.
